laboratory.finite_ship_bench: Exp34 EMI feasible, In knee and In 5 kV lanes; 10 kg wet, 8 kg dry, 100 W cap. State is integrated in Earth time with mass, rapidity, distance and ship proper time. Throttle profiles: FULL=1, ECO25=0.25, RAMP to 1 over 10% of estimated full-burn time, PULSE50 with 50% duty. No gamma/n target stops the run; propellant exhaustion does.
laboratory.external_throttle_bench: 8 kg test article at constant dry mass, externally powered, integrated in proper time under 0.1g/1g/10g FULL plus 1g RAMP and PULSE50. This bench is explicitly not a closed onboard-fuel ship; required external energy and instantaneous power are recorded.
laboratory.readouts_not_targets: epsilon=1/gamma and log10(gamma) may be plotted as diagnostics, but no n/gamma value is a control target in either bench.
